query:
-- First, check for existing duplicates
SELECT 
  LOWER(TRIM(email)) as normalized_email,
  companyId,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id) as user_ids
FROM users
WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND companyId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(email)), companyId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
